২১১. "It was an authoritative personal message to Richard Nixon from Chou En-lai, who emphasized that he spoke not only for himself but also for Chairman Mao and Vive Chairman Lin Piao. China, Chou declared, 'has always been willing and has always tired to negotiate by peaceful means.... In order to discuss the subject to the vacation of Chinese territories called Taiwan, a special envoy of President Nixon's will be most welcome in Peking." Henry Kissinger, _Ibid_, p.701.

২১২. "We both (Nixon and Kissinger) recognized that we had opened up new opportunitics for our diplomacy." Henry Kissinger, _Ibid_, p.757.

২১৪. "we do not recognize the authority of any Government to constitute a commission to inquire into the issue".

২১৫. Pakistan had been the first to move its troops to the border and no one had asked them to withdraw. It was only after India moved its troops to the border that proposals were make for withdrawals. Yahya's problems had been self-created and 'we are not in a position to make this easier for him.' That was one of the reasons why India could not withdraw its troops. India was being asked to allow the misdeeds of Yahya to stand and "we are not going to allow that."

২১৬. "No one in all of India was more opposed to war than she was. 'I wouldn't like to take this country to war', but, added, 'that war and this situation are not of our making.'
